2608.23313.title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
2608.23313.paper_summary: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.
2608.23313.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型的安全基準通常僅評估最終回應：模型是否拒絕、警告或遵從。這種結果導向的觀點無法告訴我們模型是否因正確的多模態原因而安全。看似安全的行為可能反映關鍵字觸發的拒絕、錯過的視覺危險，或對無害敏感輸入的過度拒絕。我們引入了 EviSafe，一個基於證據的 VLM 安全框架，該框架共同評估自然用戶面對的行為、在文本和視覺證據中的明確基礎，以及對安全關鍵證據中反事實變化的行為敏感性。EviSafeBench 將該框架實現為一個受控基準，包含 1,181 個黃金圖像-文本場景和 2,452 個針對性的反事實變體，涵蓋八個安全領域和八種類型的風險來源。每個場景包括一個黃金安全決策、證據註釋、一個安全回應政策和反事實干預。三探針協議使用自然回應、證據報告和反事實回應提示來查詢模型，然後使用證據意識評判者對其進行評分。在評估的十一個 VLM 中，自然嚴重性準確性範圍從 27.6% 到 52.8%，放鬆的診斷一致性從 6.1% 到 29.3%，不安全到安全的反事實轉換成功率從 30.4% 到 58.4%。這些差距顯示，被評估的 VLM 在正確的多模態原因下並不可靠地安全，並促使我們在拒絕計數之外進行評估。
